laga Airport just 30 minutes away. The tight-knit centre of La Cala village offers a wide range of services to residents in the local area, as well as a very good choice of restaurants, tapas bars and cafés fronting either the old town or the long, sandy beach dotted with little coves as it follows the sweep of the coast.

With only 15 exclusive independent villas available, these La Cala Golf villas are set to be popular. Boasting luxury qualities, avant-garde design, pure lines, neutral colours and large open plan spaces they are the perfect family home. The main living area features double height areas and floor-to-ceiling windows that lead out onto a private garden with a beautiful terrace that includes a personal infinity pool.

The exciting prospect with these La Cala Golf villas includes multiple options to personalise the property and make it unique. You could add a leisure room, gym and spa, underfloor heating or include up to two further bedrooms.

Each villa has 3 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms. Bedrooms have fitted wardrobes and wooden floors whilst the rest of the villa has large porcelain floor tiles. The stunning master suite has doors onto a private terrace where you can watch beautiful sunsets. Every aspect of these properties shouts luxury and there are beautiful views from almost every room.

The crowning glory of these La Cala Golf villas is a large rooftop terrace that covers the entire upper part of each of the houses. Up here you can create your own personal oasis and enjoy superb panoramic views whilst relaxing in the sun.

There is a private carport garage for two cars and this select development is in a private gated community. As mentioned there are just 15 villas available on this stylish development so contact us today to reserve your favorite.

Prices from 395,000 to 430,000 Euros
